description: P6 XER Advanced Analyzer is a Power BI custom visual built for project controls professionals working with Oracle Primavera P6 schedules. It allows users to load and parse XER files directly within Power BI — no external tools required. The visual delivers real-time schedule intelligence through four core analytical views: a color-coded Gantt chart with baseline comparison and slippage indicators, an EVM S-curve displaying Planned Value, Earned Value, and Actual Cost trends, a Total Float distribution histogram with color-coded risk buckets, and a KPI dashboard showing CPI, SPI, Cost Variance, Schedule Variance, and Estimate at Completion. Designed for project managers, schedulers, and cost engineers, it instantly flags critical path activities, near-critical tasks, float-at-risk items, and schedule delays. All data processing is performed locally within the Power BI sandbox — no data is transmitted externally, ensuring full confidentiality of sensitive project information. Seamlessly integrates with Power BI reports, slicers, and dashboards for unified, real-time project reporting across your organization.
